args.content:
Hawaii Packing List

Based on your vacation itinerary for Hawaii (June 10-20, 2024), here's your packing list:

Essential Items:
- Swimwear (for beach days, snorkeling, and kayaking)
- Sunscreen (essential for all outdoor activities)
- Hiking gear (for Diamond Head hike)
- Casual outfits (for shopping, dining, and relaxation)
- Camera (to capture memories of your trip)
- Travel documents (passport, tickets, reservations)

Activity-Specific Items:
- Beach gear (for Waikiki Beach and North Shore)
- Snorkeling equipment (optional - can be rented)
- Hiking shoes/boots (for Diamond Head)
- Comfortable walking shoes
- Light jacket or sweater (for air-conditioned places)
- Formal outfit (for the Luau experience)

Additional Recommendations:
- Sunglasses
- Hat
- Beach towel
- Water bottle
- First aid kit
- Insect repellent
- Phone charger
- Travel adapter (if needed)
